en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), and the Triplet on Having the Path as Object (Maggārammaṇattika).

Conditioned by a state that is non-visible and impinging, not having the Path as its object, a state that is non-visible and non-impinging, having the Path as its object, arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is non-visible and impinging, not having the Path as its root, a state that is non-visible and non-impinging, having the Path as its root, arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is non-visible and impinging, but not dominated by the Path, there arises a state that is non-visible and non-impinging and dominated by the Path, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
